daily_report_items: Albemarle's Q2 realized lithium pricing, volume, EBITDA, cash, liquidity, and lower capex improved the recovery evidence, but USD 9.93/USD 131.25/USD 231.62 scenarios produce only 6.04% weighted upside to the USD 118.84 pre-release mark and severe bear downside. The 31 July volume anomaly is pre-results risk evidence rather than a trade signal; Albemarle remains Hold / Watch with no paper strategy.

evidence.claim: The SEC-filed exhibit reports Q2 net sales of USD 1.743 billion, adjusted EBITDA of USD 858.1 million, operating cash flow of USD 710 million, company-defined free cash flow of USD 638 million, Energy Storage realized price of USD 19.53/kg LCE, and Energy Storage volume of 65 kt LCE. It also identifies Talison-dividend and non-recurring working-capital timing benefits, lowers expected 2026 capex to about USD 500 million, and retains USD 10/USD 20/USD 30 per kg LCE sensitivity cases.

The SEC-filed quarterly report confirms June 30 cash of USD 1.632 billion, total debt of about USD 1.877 billion, diluted weighted-average common shares of 136.212 million for Q2, mandatory-convertible preferred treatment, current cash-flow evidence, and the balance-sheet and risk inputs used by the assessment.

The canonical 31 July alert records a 13.22% decline from 2 July to USD 117.64, 3.65 million shares of volume, and source-price hash 611da3261bdad867dcad82644a7fbd61b659a01d7f43e83682f9eb8dbbb79382. The current identity-matched mark is USD 118.83999633789062 for 5 August, with RSI 38.33 and volume z-score 0.30; the USD/EUR rate is 0.866100013256073. Because Q2 was released after the 5 August close, the mark predates a regular-session results reaction.
evidence.source: PaperTrader deterministic market, indicator, and FX caches

evidence.claim: Deterministic normalization derived a USD 126.0125 probability-weighted fair value, 6.0354% expected return, 4.5266% confidence-adjusted expected return, 10.4426% base return, and 91.6442% bear downside. The assessment is complete but ineligible because expected return and bear/base and expected/bear payoff gates fail; its canonical rating and action are Hold / Watch.

source_items.summary: Reassessed Albemarle after Q2 2026 and the 31 July volume anomaly. Q2 net sales, realized lithium pricing, volume, EBITDA, cash generation, liquidity, and lower capex improved the operating evidence, while non-recurring working-capital timing, commodity sensitivity, Talison disruption, tax, and mandatory-convertible dilution remain material. Replaced the unsupported legacy valuation with a scenario-complete cyclical normalized-earnings assessment: USD 9.93 bear, USD 131.25 base, and USD 231.62 bull at 25%/50%/25%. The USD 126.0125 weighted value is only 6.04% above the USD 118.84 pre-release mark; confidence-adjusted expected return and payoff asymmetry fail the economic gates. Albemarle remains watching with Hold / Watch, no strategy, and exactly one dependent lithium-idea refresh.
